nodes.label: Time-travel paper absorption map (working)
nodes.author: Matthew Lach
nodes.rationale: The paper is written against The Method 1.3 and the current book is 1.6, cumulative, so each result must be sorted into already absorbed, superseded, or genuinely outstanding — the three-bucket status is left unfilled until the diff against 1.6 is run.

nodes.label: The clock was an assumption, not a law
nodes.author: Matthew Lach
nodes.rationale: The occupancy result holds for non-accretive destinations rather than only empty ones, and §7.1 silently assumes empty; at §7.4 caps 31.6% of composable steps run backwards in the index that distinguishes placed-from-present g.

nodes.label: Treeness is the load-bearing hypothesis, never named
nodes.author: Matthew Lach
nodes.rationale: Decay theorem, Markov property, balance identity and cut law all rest on the constraint graph being a tree, and all four fail at Lambda-9-prime — the one tower stage that closes a cycle.

nodes.label: The reversed index is lawful; the union is not closed (E = 2,857)
nodes.author: Matthew Lach
nodes.rationale: The two indices agree on 389 cells and their intersection is a groupoid with identities and two-sided inverses, but the union fails to close at E = 2,857 — so a structure containing both directions of time is not available at any price.

nodes.label: The 2,475-cell two-parent K discrepancy
nodes.author: Matthew Lach
nodes.rationale: §12.11.5 prices the tight two-parent K at 2,475 cells (3.5%), while four disjoint routes at §7.4 caps give 15,150 at Lambda-12 and 45,450 at Lambda-13 on a rebuild that reproduces every other tower figure. Recorded, not claimed.

nodes.label: Brylawski withdrawal — the partition-lattice claim
nodes.author: Matthew Lach
nodes.rationale: The object is Brylawski's 1973 lattice of integer partitions, found by one search after four turns; the claim is withdrawn and what survives is the closure defect of the dominance order, which the search did not return. The n-body work is retained as the route by which later work was reached.
